displayIdentity.body: Practices and dangers press the resurrection question. Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead? Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
displayIdentity.title: Practices and dangers press the resurrection question
